:root{--sf-hair:rgba(17,17,17,.16);--sf-hair-strong:rgba(17,17,17,.3)}body{-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}h1,h2,h3{text-wrap:balance}.sf-eyebrow{font-family:var(--wp--preset--font-family--space-grotesk);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}.sf-hair{border-top:1px .sfcore-portfolio__meta-item{order:3;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-4);display:flex;gap:.4rem}.sfcore-portfolio 1.1rem;font-family:var(--wp--preset--font-family--space-grotesk);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-4);transition:all .2s
